description:
FILED s470a5 (Opus) at the merge review of #996 half A5.  Pl::VarAnnotator is
SCALAR-ONLY by construction: `_analyze_tree''s decl walk does
`next unless $var =~ /^\$\w+$/', and the verdict loop runs over
`keys %{$ctx->{decl_count}}', so no `@name' ever gets a verdict at all.  Three
separate items are waiting on the same missing fact family.

=== WHAT THE FACTS ARE ===

Per ARRAY name in a region, at least:
  * NEVER-WRITTEN-IN-REGION -- no element store, no push/pop/shift/unshift/
    splice, no whole-container assignment, no `local', no `undef @a', no tie,
    no aliasing foreach over it that writes;
  * NON-ESCAPING -- never referenced (`\@a'), never passed whole, never
    captured by a closure, never `@_'.
Both are the shape #996's A3 sizing describes; the second is A3's own licence.

=== WHAT IT UNBLOCKS ===

(1) #996 HALF A3.  `push @a, SCALAR' on a never-referenced, non-escaping `my
    @a' can become `(%p-push1 @a X)' -- `%p-array-store-scalar' plus the new
    length -- instead of p-push-impl's &rest consing, array-shape type test
    and four-way per-item cond.  Measured ceiling -40.9 % (`pushloc'
    0.48x -> ~0.29x of perl).  See #996 for the emission sketch and why the
    licence must be a PROVEN fact, not a shape test at the push site.

(2) foreach-raw's WRITE-TO-THE-ARRAY HOLE (this is the new part).  The
    `foreach-raw' verdict says the LOOP VARIABLE is only ever read, and binds
    the slot AS IT STANDS instead of promoting it to a box.  That covers a
    write THROUGH the loop variable.  It does NOT cover a write to the ARRAY
    by another path during the loop, because there are no array facts to ask.

    REPRODUCER A -- plain foreach, no sort involved (scratch/s470a5/probe/
    wrarr.pl on this tree):

        my @fa = (1,2,3);
        for my $x (@fa) { $fa[0] = 99; print "plain:$x\n"; last }

      perl 5.40.3            plain:99
      PCL (default)          plain:1
      PCL PCL_OPT=none       plain:99
      PCL PCL_OPT=-foreach-raw  plain:99      <-- attributes it exactly

    perl aliases $x to $fa[0], so the write during the iteration is visible
    through $x.  With `foreach-raw' the slot's VALUE was bound before the
    write, so $x still reads 1.

(3) classic-sort's FOREACH LICENCE (#996 A5, shipped s470a5).  The pass counts
    a `p-foreach-raw' list as a copying consumer -- it consults foreach-raw's
    own verdict, deliberately, rather than computing a second one -- so it
    inherits exactly the same boundary and no more:

        my @fs = (3,1,2);
        for my $x (sort { $a <=> $b } @fs) { $fs[1] = 99; print "sorted:$x\n"; last }

      perl 5.40.3               sorted:99
      PCL (default)             sorted:1
      PCL PCL_OPT=none          sorted:99
      PCL PCL_OPT=-classic-sort sorted:99
      PCL PCL_OPT=-foreach-raw  sorted:99

    RULED AT THE s470a5 MERGE REVIEW: this is NOT a new hole and classic-sort's
    foreach licence STAYS.  It is as sound as foreach-raw itself, which is the
    thing that has to become exact.  No Pl/t row asserts the wrong answer;
    Pl/t/classic-sort-01.t's header states the boundary and points here.

=== THE BAR ===

The array-fact family is a NEW VERDICT over a name kind the annotator has
never classified, so it is a name-resolution-shaped change: the full sweep IS
the gate (WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN), plus a gate-SET scan over both populations if any
checker or refusal widens.  Both reproducers above become guard rows asserting
PERL's answer (99 / 99) in the commit that closes the hole -- not before.


=== DONE (s470bj) ===

SHIPPED.  Two facts per `my @name` declared in a region, computed by the ONE
existing walk in Pl/VarAnnotator.pm (no second scanner â the s379 standing
rule); ir-spec Â§2.3a is the normative statement, Â§5.4 and Â§6.2 say what they
license; guard Pl/t/array-facts-01.t (61 rows, 8.4 s), inverse-verified on an
e73038f worktree where exactly 23 rows fail.  Generation v2-720; commit
d54b798 (rebased onto main 92a568e).

  * `escapes` â the container or an element is reachable under some name other
    than this lexical: \@a, \$a[i], passed WHOLE to a call/method/code ref, a
    nested sub (anon OR NAMED) names it, tie, blessed through a ref, a string
    eval in the region, a redeclaration, the list of a foreach whose loop var
    is not proven read-only, or ANY POSITION THE WALK HAS NOT CLASSIFIED.
  * `written_in(REGION)` â a direct write inside a for/foreach BODY block,
    keyed by that block's refaddr (VarAnnotator and Parser2 see one document).

THE POLARITY IS THE DESIGN: `_tw_walk` gained a 6th argument `$aread` ("an
@name leaf here is only READ"), passed at the ~20 classified recursion sites
and ABSENT everywhere else, so an unforeseen spelling costs an optimization
and never a value.

THREE OF THIS TASK'S OWN GUESSES ABOUT PERL WERE WRONG (probed, 5.40.3 â
scratch/s470bj/probe/sem1.pl in the agent worktree):
  1. `reverse @a` HANDS ALIASES BACK (`$_++ for reverse @a` increments @a),
     and so do `sort @a` with NO block and `values @a`.  They are therefore
     neither reads nor escapes but ALIAS-TRANSPARENT: they pass their own
     position's licence through (an assignment copies; `f(sort @a)` escapes;
     a foreach is the foreach's business).  `map`/`grep` are NOT transparent â
     their block sees `$_` aliased and can take a reference to it
     (`my @r = map { \$_ } sort @c` hands out `\$c[i]`).
  2. A SYMBOLIC REFERENCE CANNOT REACH A `my` ARRAY, so this task's blanket
     `@{"a"}` / `@$name` escape is unnecessary: `no strict 'refs'; my @a=(1,2);
     push @{"a"}, 5` leaves @a at 2 and puts the 5 in @main::a.  The only path
     to a lexical is `*a = \@a`, which takes a reference â already an escape.
  3. `return @a` and a sub's TAIL value copy (the call boundary), the same
     finding s470a5's licence B rests on.

A `sort { â¦ }` ESCAPE IS RELAXABLE AND HAD TO BE.  The first version escaped
the array for any sort BLOCK, which silently removed classic-sort's WHOLE
foreach licence (the Pl/t/classic-sort-01.t row that asserts licence A's
p-foreach-raw member).  The comparator's only channel to the array is the
alias pair `$a`/`$b`, and this walk already records every write / `\` / alias
of those (the block body is walked with the seam flag by `_tw_expr_parse`), so
a `sort-block` escape is dropped when the region touches neither name.
Region-wide, therefore over-firing = safe.  RESIDUE #1142: a comparator that
CALLS a sub writing the package `$a`/`$b` is invisible here.

CONSUMER (2), THE HOLE: the conjunct is at the LOWERING SITE
(Parser2::_lower_compound), not folded into `foreach_ro` â the verdict is
name-keyed and two loops in a region can share `$x` over different arrays.
And it asks about EVERY array NAMED in the list (`_list_array_names`), not a
bare `@a`, because sort/reverse/values/a comma list all hand the SOURCE
array's elements through.  Both reproducers now print perl's 99 in default AND
PCL_OPT=none.

CONSUMER (3): classic-sort needed NO CODE CHANGE â it reads the
`p-foreach-raw` head by design, so it inherits the fix by construction.  Its
header comment and Pl/t/classic-sort-01.t's header (both of which said the
boundary was inexact "because VarAnnotator has no array facts at all") were
repaired in the same commit, per the s416 stale-guard rule.

BAR MET: gate 201 files / 6886 rows, only the 13 known pclxs xs rows failing;
corpus-diff 3 of 111 files (grent.t + split.t = `%p-push1`, chdir.t = one
demote), silent drops 5 unchanged, shapes identical; emission-ab lib+shapes 3
DIFF / RCDIFF 0; emission-ab WIDE (perl 5.40.3 t/ + cpan-tests, 1007 files)
SAME 966 / DIFF 41 / RCDIFF 0, every DIFF classified (36 push/foreach, 5 the
PRE-EXISTING #1118 `:captures ARRAY(0xâ¦)` nondeterminism); companion op/push.t
32/0, op/array.t 170/25, op/loopctl.t 63/4 = the blessed snapshot verbatim,
ROW DIFF 0 NEW / 0 FIXED / 0 LOST, DROPS 0; pack.t 5636/89 = baseline after
the artifact rebuild.  NO FULL SWEEP â Fable's leg over the merged batch (this
IS a name-resolution-shaped change, so the sweep is the gate for it).

DEMOTION CENSUS (16 across the four populations, cause by cause):
arg-to-grep 4 (lib/mro.pm Ã3 â line 84 `@seqs = grep { scalar @$_ } @seqs`, a
block that only READS, which is #1142's measured mover â and op/pwent.t),
arg-to-map 5, foreach-alias-rw 3 (io/utf8.t, op/signame_canonical.t â a
foreach whose var WRITES, i.e. a real escape), nested-sub+fallback-text 2
(chdir.t in both populations: `sub clean_env` names @magic_envs and the END
block mentions it, and clean_env is CALLED FROM the loop body), ref-taken 1
(Test2/Util/HashBase.pm â `\@packages`, a real escape), multi-decl 1.
subject: VarAnnotator ARRAY-fact family: never-written-in-region / non-escaping @name â licenses #996 A3, closes foreach-raw's write-to-the-array hole, and makes classic-sort's foreach licence exact
